summary.text: Josh Wheeler is a Republican who represents District 35 (Seat B) in the Idaho House of Representatives and is listed in a second term; the directory lists Wheeler as a contractor.

paragraphs.text: According to the legislature's biography, Wheeler was born and raised in Ammon, graduated from Hillcrest High School, studied construction management at BYU and received an MBA from Idaho State University.
It says Wheeler is one of the third-generation owners of Wheeler Electric, an eastern Idaho electrical contractor, and previously served on the Ammon City Council.
